+
</span>
<span class="verb-term">
past participle
</span>

<section class="card-section">
<h4 class="card-section-label">

</h4>
<div class="verb-bands">
<div class="gender-band">

</span>
</span>

<section class="card-section">
<h4 class="card-section-label">
Placement
</h4>
<div class="card-items">
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Gledao sam film.
</div>
<div class="tr">
I watched a film. (m.)
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Ja sam gledao film.
</div>
<div class="tr">
I watched a film.
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Nisam gledao film.
</div>
<div class="tr">
I did not watch a film. (m.)
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Juče sam gledao film.
</div>
<div class="tr">
Yesterday I watched a film.
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<article class="card" data-tone="future">
<header class="card-head">
<div class="card-title">
<h3>
<span lang="sr">
Futur
</span>
<em>
Future
</em>
</h3>
</div>
</header>
<section class="card-section">
<h4 class="card-section-label">
Formula
</h4>
<p class="verb-formula">
<span lang="sr">
ću/ćeš/će/ćemo/ćete/će
</span>
<span class="chart-sep">
+
</span>
<span class="verb-term">
infinitive
</span>
</p>
</section>
<section class="card-section">
<h4 class="card-section-label">
Placement / spelling
</h4>
<div class="card-items">
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Ja ću raditi.
</div>
<div class="tr">
I will work.
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Radiću.
</div>
<div class="tr">
I will work.
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Neću raditi.
</div>
<div class="tr">
I will not work.
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="card-section">
<h4 class="card-section-label">
Merged forms
</h4>
<p class="verb-list" lang="sr">
raditi → radiću, radićeš, radiće
</p>
</section>
<section class="card-section">
<h4 class="card-section-label">
-ći verbs
</h4>
<p class="verb-list" lang="sr">
ići ću, doći ću
</p>
</section>
</article>
<article class="card verb-clitic" data-tone="clitic">
<header class="card-head">
<div class="card-title">
<h3>
<span lang="sr">
se
</span>
<em>
Reflexive clitic
</em>
</h3>
</div>
</header>
<section class="card-section">
<h4 class="card-section-label">
Examples
<button aria-expanded="false" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-label="note" class="tip-chip" data-verb-note="se" type="button">
?
</button>
</h4>
<div class="card-items">
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Šetam
<mark>
se
</mark>
.
</div>
<div class="tr">
I take a walk.
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Ja
<mark>
se
</mark>
šetam.
</div>
<div class="tr">
I take a walk.
</div>
</div>
<div class="card-item">
<div class="sr" lang="sr">
Nisam
<mark>
se
</mark>
šetao.
</div>
<div class="tr">
I did not take a walk. (m.)
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</article>
### popover [data-verb-note]|[["data-verb-note","ati"]]
<article class="chart-tip">
<h4>
<i lang="sr">
-ati
</i>
: check the present
</h4>
<p>
The infinitive ending alone does not pick the present pattern. Use the 1sg form beside each verb.
</p>
</article>
### popover [data-verb-note]|[["data-verb-note","se"]]
<article class="chart-tip">
<h4>
Second position
</h4>
<p>
A clitic like
<i lang="sr">
se
</i>
stands right after the first stressed word or phrase of the clause, never first.
</p>
</article>
